notes: Four-burner LP gas grill with a side burner: 48,000 Btu/hr from the four main burners and 12,000 Btu/hr from the side burner; the 20 lb propane cylinder is not included when sold. The parts list has quantities but no part numbers, and the warranty page names Member's Mark as the warrantor.

gaps: Propane and gas_cylinder absent claims dropped: the manual saying the 20 lb tank is not included (p.3) describes the box, not a grill found in the field.
The parts list (p.7) has row numbers, descriptions and quantities but no part numbers, so no OEM part numbers are claimed.
The manual gives a manifold pressure of 11 in water column (p.8); it is not claimed because the manual does not tie it to a part.
The manual does not state the igniter's power source, so no battery is claimed. The pulse igniter module is named only on the parts list; p.10 describes the igniter as built into each valve.

Material is not claimed for the cooking grids, cart frame and cart panels. Filing the burners and cart frame as tube_frame, the casters as bearing and the grids, tamers and panels as sheet_metal is the researcher's classification; each spec names the part.
The warranty page (p.20) names Member's Mark as the warrantor; the replacement-parts page (p.16) and the warranty contact name Nexgrill, and the brand is kept as Nexgrill.
Year: the hosted file is titled 2016 but the manual itself gives no production span, so years is left blank.
Parts list rows 22 to 25 sit in a two-column table; they were aligned on the rendered page.
method: Nexgrill 720-0830H Operation Instruction Manual, document 19000470A0, 60 pages, PDF hosted by MyGrillParts (author field Nexgrill; parts orders go to Nexgrill Customer Relations). Read as text; parts list (p.7) checked on a rendered page.
PDF page numbers equal the printed page numbers.
The MyGrillParts copy is the only source used.

comps.spec: Pulse igniter module (qty 1), main burner igniter wires A to D (qty 1 each) and a side burner igniter wire (qty 1), from the parts list (p.7). The manual says the igniter is built into the valve, which clicks and sparks when the knob is pushed and turned to HI (p.10)

Regulator LP (row 24, qty 1), used with the high-capacity hose/regulator assembly supplied for a 20 lb cylinder, which has a quick coupling nut (p.8). The side burner flex gas line (row 22, qty 1) is a separate row
Main gas valves (qty 4) and side burner gas valve (qty 1), plus main manifold (qty 1) and side burner manifold (qty 1) (parts list, p.7)
Cooking grids: cooking grid with hole (qty 2) and side burner cooking grid (qty 1) (parts list, p.7)
Temperature gauge (qty 1) with its housing (qty 1) (parts list, p.7)
Main burners, qty 4, each rated 12,000 Btu/hr (p.10); the warranty page gives burners 5 years against perforation (p.20)
Side burner (qty 1) rated 12,000 Btu/hr (p.8); the side burner bowl assembly (qty 1) is a separate row (p.7)
Flame tamers, stainless steel, one above each main burner (p.10); parts list qty 4 (row 7)
Casters from the parts list (p.7): two casters (row 48), one swivel caster with brake (row 43) and one swivel caster (row 44)
Cart panels, one each: left side (row 42), right side (row 47), rear (row 41) and bottom (row 45)

sources.title: Nexgrill 720-0830H Outdoor Gas Grill Operation Instruction Manual, document 19000470A0 (PDF hosted by MyGrillParts, file titled 2016)
